[SWS_CM_90430] E2E-protected events sample serialization
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00223, RS_E2E_08540
⌈
For E2E-protected
Event
s,
Send()
/
Send()
shall serialize the sample and poten-
tially add a protocol header according to the rules of the respective network binding
(e.g., according to [SWS_CM_10291] in case of SOME/IP network binding), resulting
in serialized data.
⌋
From E2E protection perspective this serialized data include both a non-protected part
as well as the part to be protected (see [PRS_E2E_01444] and [PRS_E2E_01445]).
